econometric_drivers.title: PADD 5 West Coast Econometric Levers
econometric_drivers.description: Oakland operates within the isolated PADD 5 West Coast pricing island where retail prices reflect strict CARB CaRFG summer/winter blend specifications, regional refining tightness, and waterborne import premiums.

refining_logistics.title: Chevron Richmond Refining & Pipeline Logistics
refining_logistics.description: Located 12 miles north of Oakland, Chevron's 245,000 bpd Richmond Refinery, alongside PBF Martinez and Valero Benicia, supplies East Bay retail stations via the Kinder Morgan SFPP pipeline corridor.

tax_structure.title: CARB Environmental Tax & Regulatory Overhead
tax_structure.description: California imposes $0.953/gal state environmental tax/fee burden ($0.634 excise + $0.250 Cap-and-Trade + $0.185 LCFS + $0.150 sales/UST), yielding $1.407/gal total statutory tax with Federal excise.
tax_structure.notes: Highest regulatory and environmental tax overhead in the nation
